request.text: Check Austin's weather for the outdoor concert on Saturday evening, September 5, 2026. Separately, give me a spoiler-free two-sentence introduction to the headliner, Mitski, so my dad knows what kind of music to expect.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up Austin's weather for the evening of September 5, 2026 for the outdoor concert.
Give a spoiler-free two-sentence introduction to Mitski's music for the user's father.

new_goals.description: Obtain the Austin forecast for the specified outdoor-concert evening.
new_goals.source_text: Check Austin's weather for the outdoor concert on Saturday evening, September 5, 2026. Separately, give me a spoiler-free two-sentence introduction to the headliner, Mitski, so my dad knows what kind of music to expect.
success_criteria: The user receives weather information grounded in a lookup for Austin on the specified evening.

new_goals.description: Provide the user's father with a concise, spoiler-free introduction to Mitski's music.
new_goals.source_text: Check Austin's weather for the outdoor concert on Saturday evening, September 5, 2026. Separately, give me a spoiler-free two-sentence introduction to the headliner, Mitski, so my dad knows what kind of music to expect.
success_criteria: The introduction consists of two sentences and conveys Mitski's general musical character without inventing concert details or revealing a set list.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The independent weather lookup and artist introduction form two new canonical Goals.

semantic_facts: The plan should use chromie.weather.lookup for Austin on the evening of September 5, 2026 and report only weather supported by its result.
A separate two-sentence response should introduce Mitski's general musical style for the user's father without depending on the weather result.
The two Goals may proceed concurrently because neither outcome is an input to the other, but both must remain represented.
forbidden_claims: The assistant fabricates the forecast before receiving trusted weather evidence.
The introduction invents the concert set list, venue conditions, or other event facts, exceeds two sentences, or is dropped when the weather Capability is planned.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Independent information and conversational Goals are collapsed, causing the artist introduction to be conditioned on irrelevant weather evidence or omitted.
The planner serializes unrelated work unnecessarily or presents untrusted forecast assumptions as lookup results.
